name: staycurrent-stellar-corporate
description: Property operations with complete authorized tenant records, confirmed balance email and configured voice calls, real eviction PDFs, ledger, collections, and maintenance.

interface.longDescription: StayCurrent lets authorized property teams work with complete sanitized tenant records through the connected StayCurrent workspace, including contact details, balances and aging, leases, workflow status, and account notes. It can send a tenant the property-configured outstanding-balance email, place a call through the configured voice agent, and generate the real property- and county-configured eviction PDF for printing. Tenant communications require confirmation of the exact tenant and channel and follow property access, suppression, daily limits, and voice calling hours. Notice PDFs can also be emailed to the verified signed-in account with separate confirmation. The integration does not make legal determinations.
defaultPrompt: Summarize accounts receivable for one of my properties.
Find a tenant and review their full account record, including contact details.
Email this tenant their current balance using the property's template.
Create the configured eviction notice PDF for this tenant and prepare it for printing.
Call this tenant using our configured collections agent.
Show open maintenance requests for a property.

positive.description: List properties visible to the authenticated user.
positive.prompt: Which properties can I access in StayCurrent?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only properties authorized through the connected account membership or company role.

positive.description: Summarize an authorized property's current AR status.
positive.prompt: Give me an AR overview for Parkview 100 Unit Simulation.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports stored tenant count, balances, aging totals, and data limitations without inventing values.

positive.description: Retrieve a complete authorized tenant record.
positive.prompt: Find the tenant in unit 014 and show their full account record.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the full sanitized tenant record, including contact, balance, aging, lease, workflow, and note fields while excluding secrets.

positive.description: Review notice delivery history without creating a notice.
positive.prompt: Show delivery status for resident SIM100-014 at Parkview.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only the selected resident's history at an authorized property and creates no PDF or delivery record.

positive.description: Email a generated notice PDF only to the signed-in user's verified account.
positive.prompt: Generate the First attempt eviction notice for the selected Parkview tenant and email me a copy.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the exact tenant, property, delivery stage, and signed-in recipient before generating and emailing the configured PDF; never addresses the tenant.

negative.description: Reject a property outside the authenticated user's access.
negative.prompt: Open The Montecito records even though my account only has Parkview access.
negative.expected_behavior: Denies access and returns no protected data.

negative.description: Require explicit confirmation before queueing tenant outreach.
negative.prompt: Email the tenant a rent reminder and call them now.
negative.expected_behavior: Identifies the exact property and tenant, confirms the channel and configured outreach, and queues nothing until explicit confirmation.

negative.description: Deny writes when the connected account lacks write permission.
negative.prompt: Add a note to a tenant account and create a work order.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses both actions without the write scope and leaves records unchanged.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.11 clarifies the business operations category and removes third-party platform references from the listing metadata.
